evals.prompt: Our triage cycle wrapped up this morning — please turn every decision in .vulnetix/memory.yaml into an OpenVEX document we can hand to the auditor.
evals.expected_output: An OpenVEX JSON file written under .vulnetix/vex/<timestamp>.vex.json containing one statement per non-investigating memory entry, with a summary table of counts per VEX status and the local file path.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/memory.yaml and filters to entries whose decision.choice is not 'investigating'
Runs `vulnetix triage --provider vulnetix --vex-format openvex -o json` and writes the result under .vulnetix/vex/<timestamp>.vex.json
Maps decision.choice → VEX status using the closed dict (not-affected/risk-avoided→not_affected, fix-applied→fixed, risk-accepted/deferred/mitigated→affected, investigating→under_investigation)
Renders the final report with counts for not_affected, fixed, affected (with mitigations), and under_investigation
Reports Uploaded: no and PR comment: no because --upload was not requested and no PR context was detected

evals.prompt: Generate a CycloneDX VEX attestation from our triage decisions and upload it to Vulnetix so customers can consume it alongside the SBOM.
evals.expected_output: A CycloneDX VEX document generated and uploaded via the Vulnetix CLI, with the local path and upload confirmation surfaced in the report.
expectations: Invokes `vulnetix triage --provider vulnetix --vex-format cyclonedx -o json` (CycloneDX schema, not OpenVEX)
Notes the upload requires authenticated CLI and may rate-limit on community tier
Final report includes Uploaded: yes and the VEX statement counts grouped by status

evals.prompt: We're on a CI runner reviewing PR #482 — publish the VEX statements and drop a summary comment on the PR so reviewers see the security disposition.
evals.expected_output: VEX file generated locally and a Markdown summary posted as a GitHub PR comment via gh, with the report indicating both the file path and that the PR comment was posted.
expectations: Checks .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml for binaries.gh: true and detects PR context via GITHUB_REF or `gh pr view --json number`
Generates the VEX via `vulnetix triage --provider vulnetix --vex-format openvex -o json` to .vulnetix/vex/<timestamp>.vex.json
Produces a Markdown summary file .vulnetix/vex/<timestamp>.vex.summary.md rendered from the VEX JSON
Posts the summary with `gh pr comment <PR_NUMBER> --body-file .vulnetix/vex/<timestamp>.vex.summary.md`
Final report shows PR comment: yes and breakdown of statements by VEX status (not_affected/fixed/affected/under_investigation)
